executive_summary: Chapter 8 classifies matter into pure substances (elements, compounds) and mixtures (uniform/homogeneous, non-uniform/heterogeneous). It demonstrates chemical synthesis (Fe+S -> FeS), water electrolysis into H2 and O2 (2:1 volume ratio), word equations, and metallic alloys.
